skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of corporate governance, risk management, and internal control principles to form an internal audit process based on risk assessment.
Identify and evaluate risks for audit subjects to build an audit program.
Design procedures to collect audit evidence that meet evidence requirements.
Manage the internal audit function, including planning, execution, and follow-up of audit conclusions.
Prepare audit reports that establish trust in audit results for users.
Adhere to ethical standards in internal audit practice.
Understand the relationship between corporate governance, risk management, and internal control with the internal audit function.
Understand the relationship between risk management and the internal audit function.
Understand the relationship between internal control and the internal audit function.
Conduct internal audits in a technology environment.
Detect and investigate fraud in an organization.
Plan and design audit programs based on risk assessment.
Execute audit programs and document findings.
Report audit findings and communicate results.
